problem_context.expected_behavior: Treat linklist as a non-null sentinel head and return its first data-node pointer, which may be NULL for an empty list, without changing the list.
problem_context.input_output_contract: Require xizi_sll_head(linklist,l). Ensure return equals the head node_next value and xizi_sll_head(linklist,l) is preserved.
spec_hint: Use xizi_sll_head for the public sentinel-head contract. Expose the returned first pointer existentially or by equality only as needed; preserve full ownership.
preferred_hidden_properties: xizi_sll_head(linklist,l) unfolds to an existential first with linklist->node_next=first * xizi_sll(first,l).
forbidden_patterns: Do not model the sentinel itself as a data node; do not require a nonempty data chain; do not mirror the getter as a Rocq algorithm.
reference_case_hints: Use the migrated sentinel-head contracts in OUTPUT/xizi/xizi_single_link_init and OUTPUT/xizi/xizi_single_link_len, and the common xizi_single_link definition.

Do not restate the C loops as the mathematical definition.
